hook: Preston is a finance executive who led two federal agencies, serving as Administrator of the Small Business Administration from 2006 and as Secretary of Housing and Urban Development from 2008 to 2009. He later ran Oakleaf Global Holdings and Livingston International, and has led Goodwill Industries International since 2019. His AI work runs through workforce training, including a 2026 Verizon programme in which local Goodwills coach people as they learn practical AI skills.
name: Steve Preston

quick_facts: Graduated with highest distinction from Northwestern University and holds an MBA from the University of Chicago.
Worked as an investment banker at Lehman Brothers and as senior vice president and treasurer of First Data Corporation.
Was executive vice president and chief financial officer of The ServiceMaster Company.
Took over the Small Business Administration in July 2006 and was sworn in as the 14th Secretary of Housing and Urban Development on June 5, 2008.
Was CEO of Oakleaf Global Holdings from 2009 to 2011, chief financial officer of Waste Management until 2012, and CEO of Livingston International from August 2013.
Is identified as CEO of Goodwill Industries International in a Verizon announcement of September 23, 2026.

achievements.title: Administrator, U.S. Small Business Administration
achievements.impact: Streamlined disaster lending for victims of Hurricane Katrina and cut the agency's loan backlog by 80 percent, according to the White House's 2008 nomination announcement.

achievements.title: 14th U.S. Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
achievements.impact: Led the department from June 2008 to January 2009, during a national financial crisis.

achievements.title: Private sector turnarounds
achievements.impact: Led turnarounds as CEO of Oakleaf Global Holdings and Livingston International, and served as chief financial officer of Waste Management and ServiceMaster through periods of restructuring.

achievements.title: President and CEO, Goodwill Industries International
achievements.impact: Leads the umbrella organisation for more than 150 local, independent Goodwill organisations, which served more than 2.1 million people in 2022 with training, career navigation and job placement.

achievements.title: AI skills training
achievements.impact: Goodwill began offering Google's AI Essentials course at no cost in 2025, with a goal of training 200,000 people, and in September 2026 became one of three community partners in Verizon AI Skills for America, giving local coaching to people taking free AI courses.
